title: A dimension-free bound for isoperimetry of unconditional log-concave measures
summary: We prove a dimension-free Poincaré inequality for isotropic unconditional log-concave probability measures, establishing the Kannan-Lovász-Simonovits (KLS) conjecture in the unconditional setting. The proof combines a new application of Dunkl operator theory combined with an appropriate transformation of the log-concave measure. Specifically, the proof follows by a direct spectral analysis of a new Dunkl-Langevin operator adapted to the transformed measure.
